newEntriesNeeded.title: LOOPDATA Object — Data Export and Logging
newEntriesNeeded.principle: LOOPDATA is an AVEVA system object for exporting loop data and instrument field information to external files.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use PML RELOAD OBJECT LOOPDATA before instantiation. Create with object LOOPDATA(), then call GetData(), InstrumentFieldDataTransfer(), set pathName, and call SaveLog() to export.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB loop-data-update.pmlmac
PML RELOAD OBJECT LOOPDATA
!loop = object LOOPDATA()
!loop.GetData()
!loop.InstrumentFieldDataTransfer(FALSE)
!loop.pathName = |C:\path\to\log|
!loop.SaveLog(|loop-data-update-log.xlsx|, FALSE)
pitfalls: LOOPDATA must be reloaded before use in a new PML session.
pathName must point to a writable directory.
SaveLog second argument controls overwrite behavior; FALSE means do not overwrite.
